references.context: Work the left and right side targets to spell TRUE LOVE.
references.label: TRUE and LOVE targets
references.description: The side-target banks beneath the upper flippers spell TRUE on the left and LOVE on the right.

references.context: Shoot Max's Hut to start True Love Multiball.
references.label: Max's Hut
references.description: The captured-ball shot left of the center ramp starts True Love and collects Mystery awards.

references.context: Qualify a Castle mode at the Castle ramp.
references.label: Castle ramp
references.description: The far-left ramp qualifies and starts Castle modes and starts Prepare to Die Multiball.

references.context: Shoot Guilder and complete Cliffs of Insanity.
references.label: Cliffs of Insanity
references.description: The center-right drop and moving magnet assembly qualifies Guilder story modes.
